blockingIssues.problem: The title unconditionally prescribes "Fix Narrative first" whereas the source prescribes targeting the first stage supported by evidence and only notes that Narrative is the most recurrent locus; it does not mandate Narrative-first for every trial.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Implication for the next focused trial: "Targets the first stage supported by the evidence for the chosen failure (Narrative is the most recurrent locus; compare its actual input Synthesis before changing it)." Also: "Do not infer that another Idea-only change or a Compose-only style change will address every failure."
blockingIssues.constraint: The next trial must target the first stage supported by the evidence for the specific failure; Narrative is a frequently observed locus but not an unconditional, universal first intervention.
